description: This file contains functions for generating customer acquisition and loyalty reports, including data aggregation by time and territory, using the Frappe framework.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report data based on filters, dispatching to time-based or territory-based data retrieval.

methods.name: get_data_by_time
methods.description: Retrieves customer data aggregated by month within a date range.

methods.name: get_data_by_territory
methods.description: Retrieves customer data aggregated by territory, including hierarchy processing.

methods.name: get_customer_stats
methods.description: Calculates number of new and repeat customers and their revenue, optionally structured for a tree view.
